Use believable high-detail rendered materials, warm natural daylight from upper left, coherent three-quarter depth, crisp contact shadows, readable silhouettes and a restrained dark slate/brushed bronze interface. The scene should resemble a finished ambitious strategy game. Compose it for a horizontal phone; world or character dominates, compact HUD at safe edges. Use original architecture and composition, no copied reference art, no cartoon/vector/diagram aesthetic, no generic dashboard or excessive glass cards. Modern icons are recognisable miniature material objects; navigation has one thin rim, resources have no medallion background. Four campaign resources only: Food, Wood, Stone, Gold; no resource HUD in Tactical, Defense or battle results. No account/server/cloud/store/online controls. Use only minimal short readable UI text and a single interface layer. No invented faction names, currencies, hex rules or extra creatures. This is an appearance mock only; do not imply playable code or exact legal geometry. Wide cinematic valley and a powerful original stone citadel on the right two-thirds; game title and restrained Continue/New Game controls in the left third. Small Settings/local-save access. No resource bar on entry. The reusable entry layout must support each campaign age through its own age-correct background treatment; this first mock calibrates Medieval. No server selector or account login.
